timestamp_model: Four timestamps per observation (NOTES 68.11.1.2): observation_time, underlying_public_time, source_available_time, retrieved_at_utc. ACCESS RULE: a model may consume a value only when source_available_time <= t. Per-observation values come from tools/g3_exogenous_loader.py; NO UTC release constant exists anywhere in this manifest.
revisable_series_rule: Any future revisable series (CPI/PCE/NFP class) must carry revision_id/vintage fields: observation -> publication -> revision -> retrieval, four distinct fields (68.11.1.2). None staged yet.
raw_data_policy: Vendor/index raw data is NEVER committed; public-domain series may be, by explicit licence_class (NOTES 68.11.3). Restricted raw files live untracked in data/exogenous/raw/.
panel_split: Panel A: daily baseline (staged here). Panel B: event-driven/intraday requires futures-quality time-resolved instruments; cash indices are NOT substitutes there (68.11.2). The procurement question is whether the intraday branch is activated.
adoption_decisions_open: DTWEXBGS broad-dollar in place of ICE DXY (different basket, recorded) - RESOLVED (NOTES 70.1.2): adopted as the USD measure
FRED cash SP500/NASDAQ100 in place of ES/NQ for Panel A only (overnight-gap limitation recorded) - RESOLVED (NOTES 70.1.2): adopted, Panel A only; Panel B deferred (NOTES 70.1.3)
gold: included at all, and from where (candidate UNVERIFIED) - RESOLVED (NOTES 70.1.2): NOT adopted; UNVERIFIED stands
open_refinements: exact per-source release calendars (current impl: conservative Fed+NYSE/CBOE union, anti-lookahead by construction)
public-history blob remediation for d8820ca restricted CSVs (open item, lock-hash concern, NOTES 68.11.3)
measured FRED serving times to replace BOTH conservative aggregator rules (the after-publisher-release rule for Fed series and the mirror rule for index closes)
source_chain_rule: Every series distinguishes publisher (who originates the value) from retrieval_source (who serves our bytes); access is governed by the retrieval source's availability under a delay-only rule (NOTES 68.12.1). publisher == retrieval_source only where genuine.
